goal: Deliver a verified native Rust MCP skill router, complete 98-source index refresh, isolated internal deployment and current English GitHub documentation/report.
acceptance: All 98 authorized GitHub sources are pinned and completely discovered; every SKILL.md path is represented by an indexed source row or an exact recorded omission. Zero discovery, fetch or parse failures are required before publication; failed refresh preserves the previous corpus.

A native official-SDK Rust MCP runtime exposes skills_stats, skills_search and skills_route over stdio and authenticated internal Streamable HTTP, uses read-only SQLite with snapshot-consistent provenance, and never launches Python, a shell or skill code.

Request, response, text and concurrency limits are exercised against the actual compiled binary; Jev validation preserves full candidate accounting, partial/degraded and no-valid-answer distinctions, bounded retries and redacted errors.

Independent source-based specification and security reviews approve the exact source. Python regression/selftest and actual Rust format/test/Clippy/release plus stdio/HTTP smoke checks pass. Synthetic fixtures are labeled offline, never live provider evidence.

The tested binary and a verified consistent DB snapshot run in a dedicated non-login Odin systemd service with root-owned code, read-only data, protected secrets and a Tailnet-only bind. Real authenticated MCP-to-Jev ranking and cross-host access pass, and artifact/corpus identities match.

Current English documentation and a regenerated evidence-based report distinguish retrieval, ranking, validation, degraded results and provenance. Reviewed changes are published through a PR; remote contents and any authorized default-branch update are read back. No history rewriting, secrets or unrelated project changes.
checks: .venv/bin/python3 -B -c "import ast,pathlib; [ast.parse(p.read_text()) for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*.py') if not any(x in p.parts for x in ('.venv','.git','target'))]"

test.when: A concrete trust-boundary regression is missing
test.brief: Add the smallest runnable failing check for the known defect. Preserve assertions and scope.

fix.brief: Fix the demonstrated root cause in the shared path, retaining atomic publication and strict validation.

build.brief: Complete only the official-SDK native runtime and prove real compilation and integration against the actual index schema.

docs.when: Reviewed implementation is checked but deployment/report/publication remains
docs.brief: Deploy only the authorized internal new service, verify actual artifact/endpoint/provider/corpus behavior, regenerate English evidence and publish only reviewed work. Never substitute a completion claim for a blocker.
